# Neumorphism

Softly raised surfaces with tactile, understated depth.

## Use

Use for small tools, settings panels, and focused utility cards.

## Essential traits

- Raised and inset relief
- Monochrome surface family
- Explicit boundaries on controls

## Typography

System sans-serif with clear medium-weight labels.

## Layout and surfaces

Spacious inset and raised groups with explicit labels. Paired soft light/dark shadows and clear control outlines.

## Palette

- background: #e8edf1
- surface: #e8edf1
- text: #263544
- muted: #526171
- accent: #275c78
- border: #aab7c3

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Neumorphism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with clear medium-weight labels. Spacious inset and raised groups with explicit labels. Paired soft light/dark shadows and clear control outlines. Palette: background #e8edf1, surface #e8edf1, text #263544, muted #526171, accent #275c78, border #aab7c3. Essential traits: Raised and inset relief; Monochrome surface family; Explicit boundaries on controls. Avoid: Shadow-only affordances; Low-contrast text; Unlabeled states. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
